caseNameFull: Northern Cedar Company v. Frank H. Gloyd, as Director of Agriculture of the State of Washington Yakima County Horticultural Union v. Frank H. Gloyd, as Director of Agriculture of the State of Washington and C. W. Chamberlain & Company v. Frank H. Gloyd, as Director of Agriculture of the State of Washington
attorneys: Mr. Dallas v. Halverstadt for plaintiffs,in error. Mr. John H. Dunbar for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Louisiana Navigation Co. v. Oyster Commission, 226 U. S. 99, 101; Coe v. Armour Fertilizer Works, 237 U. S. 413, 418, 419; Gray’s Harbor Logging Co. v. Coats-Ford*626ney Logging Co., 243 U. S. 251, 255; Bruce v. Tobin, 245 U. S, 18, 19.

Mr. Dallas v. Halverstadt for plaintiffs,in error. Mr. John H. Dunbar for defendants in error.
